title: WfGg Radar operational discovery and controlled runtime evolution
problem: Prevent Collector cycles from remaining RUNNING after Connector-side failures such as MAP_INGEST_FAILED, while preserving V6.19.7 stale recovery, V6.19.6 no-data continuation and all blocking safety guards.
goals: When the Connector owns a Collector cycle and a search fails, retry local Collector cycle terminalization on a bounded schedule instead of ignoring /cycle/finish failures.
Verify the Collector cycle actually reaches FAILED before considering terminalization successful.
If terminalization still cannot be proven after bounded retries, surface a *_CYCLE_TERMINALIZATION_FAILED blocker rather than silently leaving ambiguous state.
Do not terminalize cycles merely joined by the current search; only the owning search may close its cycle.
Preserve V6.19.7 recovery of already stale RUNNING cycles.
Preserve V6.19.6 no-data retry/skip/continue behavior and valid 9/9 evidence.
Keep AUTH / NETWORK / CONNECTOR / SYSTEM and infrastructure failures blocking.
non_goals: Do not write directly to the Collector SQLite database from the Connector.
Do not close cycles owned by another joined search.
Do not reinterpret MAP_INGEST_FAILED as no-data.
Do not weaken authentication, network, connector or system failure guards.
Do not change the V6.19.5 12-hour sliding session policy.
Do not execute a Last War scan during the guard-only pilot probe.

current_change.purpose: Bounded retry and verified terminalization of owned Collector cycles after Connector-side failures so MAP_INGEST_FAILED cannot leave a fresh cycle RUNNING indefinitely.

acceptance_criteria: The connector reports Autopilot version v6.19.8.
Owned Collector cycles are terminalized through the local Collector API after a failed search.
Terminalization retries are bounded to 12 attempts and verify the terminal Collector state.
If terminalization cannot be proven, the Connector surfaces a *_CYCLE_TERMINALIZATION_FAILED error.
Joined cycles are not terminalized by a non-owning search.
V6.19.6 AUTOPILOT_NO_DATA and SEED_SKIPPED_NO_DATA remain present.
Pilot installation is SHA-pinned, rollback-capable and guard-probed without a Last War scan or Collector mutation.
Production promotion requires a separate explicit human approval.
After the guard-only pilot passes, a separate explicitly approved functional pilot may run exactly one normal @federated:8131 search.
The V6.19.8 functional pilot must recover the inherited stale cycle with STALE_RUNNING_CYCLE_RECOVERED_V6197 before observing a fresh cycle.

The fresh @federated:8131 cycle must leave RUNNING and reach SUCCESS or FAILED with finished_at within 960 seconds of being observed, allowing the full 12-minute Connector search budget plus bounded V6.19.8 terminalization retries.
If the fresh cycle reaches FAILED, its Collector error must be non-empty and must not end with _CYCLE_TERMINALIZATION_FAILED.
The functional pilot keeps Last War READ-ONLY and limits Collector mutation to stale recovery, the fresh targeted evidence cycle, and its terminalization.
architecture_invariants: GitHub stores code, branches, CI and release artifacts.
ChaCha DEV on ChaChaVPS is the runtime orchestrator.
ChaChaNas remains authoritative persistent storage for project data and backups.
VPS is runtime-oriented and not the authoritative durable project store.
Producer and verifier responsibilities remain separated.
